# exportSvgDocumentAsync

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Like [`exportSvgPagesAsync`](export-svg-pages-async.md), but also returns `@font-face` CSS embedding a minimal subset (only the glyphs actually drawn) of each embedded font, so the preview renders with the exact fonts used for layout — independent of what the viewer has installed. Subsetting keeps the payload to a few KB per face.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
exportSvgDocumentAsync(document: Document, options?: SvgPageExportOptions): Promise<SvgDocumentExport>
```
